Because the thread stamp is verified against the raven nonce, the zenith audit can check it and a recycled stamp fails the binding. Each answer carries a proof-of-work stamp at 25 bits of difficulty, and the stamp is bound to the identity so it cannot be computed once and shared. A 356 account operation therefore ties up 13 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
